blocks.text: Team preview of the Utah Jazz ahead of the 2026-2027 NBA season. Last NBA season: 22-60, missed playoffs. Coach: Will Hardy (fifth season, 107-221). Season opener: Oct. 21 vs. Memphis. Departures: C Walker Kessler, PF-C Kevin Love, C Oscar Tshiebwe, SG John Konchar, SG Cody Williams, PG Kennedy Chandler, SG Bez Mbeng. Additions: G Darryn Peterson, G Josh Okogie, C-F Jaxson Hayes, C Mo Bamba, F Harrison Ingram, G Josh Green. What to expect There’s no real reason to tank anymore — the NBA’s newest anti-tanking measures saw to that — and the Jazz might finally be ready to think about […]...
